parties.respondent: Principal Secretary, Governor of Maharashtra & Ors.

summary: Political split in Shiv Sena; rival factions led by Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde; appointment of Whip and Leader disputed; validity of floor test; Governor's power to invite CM; justiciability of legislative proceedings under Article 212; interpretation of Tenth Schedule and Symbols Order; disqualification of MLAs; Nabam Rebia referred to larger Bench; power of Speaker vs Governor in disqualification; split defense no longer available post-amendment; real party determination under electoral symbolism and legislative strength; Governor's discretion upheld in appointing Shinde as CM; floor test directed validly.
final_judgment: Petitions dismissed; Governor's actions upheld; appointment of Eknath Shinde as Chief Minister valid; floor test lawful; disqualification proceedings to be decided by Speaker; interim status maintained.
